enabled.label: Enabled and enforced
enabled.plain_language: The policy is active and can require or block access according to its rules.

disabled.label: Turned off
disabled.plain_language: The policy is not active, so it cannot protect sign-ins.

enabledForReportingButNotEnforced.label: Report-only
enabledForReportingButNotEnforced.plain_language: The policy records what it would do, but it does not yet require or block anything.
